scenes.tts: In sixteen sixty-five, Robert Hooke cut an exceedingly thin slice of cork. He saw rows of tiny walled boxes. He called them cells. They were walls left by cork cells that had died. About one hundred seventy-five years passed before scientists argued that plants and animals alike are built of cells. Why did it take so long?

scenes.tts: The cell theory has six ideas. All living organisms are made of cells. Cells are the basic unit of life. All cells arise from pre-existing cells. Metabolism, all the chemical reactions in a living thing, happens inside cells. Hereditary information, called D N A, passes from cell to cell. All cells have the same basic composition.

scenes.tts: Magnification is how many times larger an image looks. Resolution is the smallest distance at which two points still look separate. Magnification makes an image bigger. Resolution decides how much detail it holds. Many cells are almost clear. A stain is a dye that sticks to some cell parts more than others. It adds contrast.
scenes.visual: Two blurred points look like one blob; magnify, still one blob; finer resolution shows two points; then a clear cell outline gains a visible nucleus when a stain is added

scenes.tts: The unaided eye separates details about zero point one millimeters apart. That is enough for an African clawed frog egg. An ordinary light microscope separates zero point two micrometers. That is enough for a cheek cell or a bacterium. An electron microscope uses electrons, which have much shorter wavelengths than visible light. It separates about one to two nanometers. That is enough for a ribosome.

That is enough for a cheek cell or a bacterium. An electron microscope uses electrons, which have much shorter wavelengths than visible light. It separates about 1 to 2 nm. That is enough for a ribosome.

scenes.tts: The theory also changed. Matthias Schleiden described plant tissues as made of cells. Theodor Schwann found the same cellular plan in animal tissues. But Schwann's model let new cells form inside a structureless fluid. That part was wrong. Robert Remak published evidence that new cells form when existing cells divide. Rudolf Virchow spread the idea: every cell comes from a cell.

scenes.tts: So why did it take better tools? A tool can show a structure only if its resolution is finer than the structure. Making the image bigger does not change that. The cell theory is a well-tested explanation, not a guess. Scientists corrected it as new evidence arrived.
